sect1.title: auth_feature Token Semantics
sect1.para: auth_feature token semantics The auth_feature attribute for ESPmethod and ESPservice elements specifies required feature access levels for each method using a comma-delimited list of tokens. These attributes should be handled consistently across static and dynamic services.

When the auth_feature attribute is defined at the service level, all tokens apply to all methods in the service. When defined at the method level, all tokens apply to that method. When defined in both, all tokens from both attributes apply to the method.

sect2.title: Feature-Independent Tokens
sect2.para: The following tokens are supported and do not reference a specific feature:

listitem.para: None – No feature access is required. When used standalone, no access is required; when combined with other tokens, it is ignored. Currently supported by esdllib and hidl.
Deferred – Effectively equivalent to None, but suggests that security will be applied by the method handler. Currently supported by esdllib and hidl.
!X (where 'X' is any value) – Reserved for future use; constraints on 'X' will be defined later. This is new syntax.

sect2.title: Permitted Feature-Specific Tokens
sect2.para: Given a feature named MyFeature, the following tokens (excluding quotes) are permitted:

listitem.para: MyFeature – The SecAccess_Read access level is required. Currently accepted by esdllib.
MyFeature:Access – The SecAccess_Access access level is required. Currently supported by esdllib and hidl.
MyFeature:Read – The SecAccess_Read access level is required. Currently supported by esdllib and hidl.
MyFeature:Write – The SecAccess_Write access level is required. Currently supported by esdllib and hidl.
MyFeature:Full – The SecAccess_Full access level is required. Currently supported by esdllib and hidl.
MyFeature:None – No access level is required for the feature. This is useful for a method attribute to bypass its service attribute. Currently supported by esdllib and hidl.

sect2.title: Forbidden Tokens
sect2.para: Given the same feature named MyFeature, the following tokens are not permitted:

listitem.para: MyFeature: – Not permitted; two shortcuts to the same value are not necessary. Currently accepted by hidl as equivalent to MyFeature:Read.

MyFeature:X (where 'X' is any value not explicitly referenced above) – Not permitted; 'X' is an error that should be addressed as soon as possible. Currently supported by hidl as equivalent to MyFeature:Full.
